messages:
eli.sales: Handing off Zephyrus Labs (MSA signed today). Key asks: private deployment (EU-West), Okta SSO, customer-managed KMS, 30-day pilot. Pilot expected ~6k tokens/day with spikes to 40k on test days. Renewal window 2026-01 but they mentioned vendor consolidation in ~10 months so flagging possible churn.

nia.csm: Thanks Eli. Owners: Nia = CSM, Raj = Support, Marco = Eng. Can you drop infra contact and provisioning secret location? Also confirm billing credit for pilot.

eli.sales: Infra contact is louise@zephyrus.ai. Provisioning creds in 1Password item Zephyrus-Provision-1755. Finance approved 45-day pilot credit; I'll forward signed confirmation.

raj.support: I'll open SUP-9001 and add runbook items: Okta metadata import, SAML test users, cert exchange, firewall allowlist, KV-cache warm-up. Will include dashboard stub (token usage, p50/p95, error rate). ETA ticket by EOD.

infra-bot: private-deploy request queued: zephyrus-eu-west (owner: marco.eng).

marco.eng: Need CIDR ranges and KMS key ARN from Louise. Proposed smoke test: 2024-05-02 09:00 UTC. Also note: they asked about private model variants later this quarter  open RFC-3050 for quant validation.

nia.csm: I'll request CIDR/KMS in kickoff invite and schedule 30-min kickoff. Setting Account Health = onboarding: in progress and Renewal Watch = high. Action items: quarterly check-ins + usage dashboard to mitigate churn.

eli.sales: Sent signed pilot credit email to finance and cc'd Nia. Forwarded note: "45-day credit up to 
c1,500".

raj.support: SUP-9001 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-9001  attachments: onboarding-checklist.md, dashboard-stub.png. Adding alerts: p95 > 350ms and route-error-rate > 1%.

marco.eng: Provisioning job infra-4720 started once CIDR/KMS provided. Will run canary during smoke test and escalate to #eng-oncall if failures.

nia.csm: Owners & next steps: Nia (kickoff, success metrics), Raj (SUP-9001 + dashboard), Marco (provision + RFC-3050), Eli (confirm infra contact and pilot credit docs). Next sync after smoke test; escalate in #eng-oncall if blocked. :white_check_mark:
